note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are a hospital group. Our accounts payable team receives 5,000 supplier invoices a month, and only 3,500 are approved within our payment terms. Late payments cost us $14,000 a month in supplier late fees.

answers.common.decision: Which changes to make to invoice approval; the finance director decides.
answers.common.audience: The finance director and the accounts payable manager.
answers.common.materials: An invoice takes 24 days on average from receipt to approval. Of that, 18 days are spent waiting in approvers' inboxes. 1,200 invoices a month have no purchase order, so the team has to find the right approver by email.
answers.consulting.current-state: Invoices are routed by email to budget holders. We sent reminder emails last quarter, which helped a little.
answers.consulting.success: Approve 95% of invoices within payment terms.
answers.consulting.constraints: No new finance system this year; changes to approval rules are allowed.
